# Stores uploaded files in an upload directory.
module Uploads
  def self.save(dir, filename, data)
    path = File.join(dir, filename)
    File.write(path, data)
    path
  end
end

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'uploads'

class UploadsTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_saves_file
    Dir.mktmpdir do |dir|
      Uploads.save(dir, 'a.txt', 'x')
      assert File.exist?(File.join(dir, 'a.txt'))
    end
  end
end
